mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID as id, PWD as password, NM as name, EMAIL as email, PHONE as phone, ADM_YN as admin FROM tb_user WHERE USER_ID = #{id} AND (DEL_YN = false or DEL_YN is null)

SELECT USER_ID as id, NM as name, EMAIL as email, PHONE as phone, ADM_YN as admin, ORG_ID as orgId, (SELECT O.ORG_NM FROM tb_org O WHERE O.ORG_ID = tb_user.ORG_ID) as orgNm FROM tb_user WHERE USER_ID != 'space' AND (DEL_YN = false or DEL_YN is null) ORDER BY USER_ID

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user ( USER_ID, PWD, NM, EMAIL, PHONE, ADM_YN, CRET_DT, UPDT_DT, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{admin}, #{createDate}, #{updateDate}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE USER_ID = #{id} AND DEL_YN = true
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET PWD = #{password}, NM = #{name}, EMAIL = #{email}, PHONE = #{phone}, ADM_YN = #{admin}, CRET_DT = #{createDate}, UPDT_DT = #{updateDate}, DEL_YN = false, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0, BLOCK_TIME = NULL, ORG_ID = NULL WHERE USER_ID = #{id} AND DEL_YN = true

UPDATE tb_user SET DEL_YN = true WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
UPDATE tb_user SET PWD = #{password}, UPDT_DT = #{updateDate} WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
UPDATE tb_user SET LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT + 1 WHERE USER_ID = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT FROM tb_user WHERE USER_ID = #{id}
